annotations.title: Create an expense draft from a receipt

description: Use this when the user shares a receipt or supplier invoice, or asks to record an expense or purchase. Saves an expense draft from a purchase receipt or supplier invoice for the user to review in Fatura Go ("Review in Fatura Go"); no expense is recorded until they save it there. Pass the fields you read from the receipt. VAT follows the app: only the VAT printed on the receipt, or 5/105 of the total when the receipt says prices include 5% VAT; otherwise no VAT and a "VAT not shown" warning. Returns the stored draft(s), warnings in plain words and the review link. A supplier with the same TRN or exactly the same name is linked; similar names are returned to choose from; no supplier is created. An open draft with the same supplier and invoice number is returned instead of a second one. Do not use it for sales invoices (create_draft_invoice) or to pay a supplier bill.

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

category.description: Expense category slug, e.g. fuel, meals, office_supplies, software. Default other.

currency.description: One of AED, SAR, USD, EUR, GBP, KWD, QAR, BHD, OMR, INR. Default the business currency.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the receipt date. Default today (UAE).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A unique string (for example a UUID) for this request: a retry with the same key returns the first result instead of writing again.

net_amount.description: The total before VAT, only when printed.

new_supplier.description: true when the user says the supplier is new although similar names exist. Nothing is created now; Fatura Go adds the supplier when the expense is saved.

reference.description: An order or PO number printed apart from the invoice number.

supplier_id.description: A supplier of the business, from the candidates a previous call returned.

supplier_invoice_number.description: The invoice or receipt number as printed.

supplier_trn.description: The SELLER's 15-digit TRN as printed (never the buyer's). Checked as check_trn does.

total.description: The grand total printed on the receipt, VAT included. Required with the receipt fields.

vat_amount.description: The VAT amount ONLY when a VAT line is printed. Leave it out when none is printed; never calculate it.

vat_included_stated.description: true ONLY when the receipt explicitly says the prices include 5% VAT (e.g. "Inclusive of 5% VAT"). A TRN alone is not such a statement.

name: create_draft_expense
